fields.label: Action
fields.description: Tool/action name exactly as reported by the connector's tools/list (e.g. "create_issue").

fields.label: Allowed
fields.description: Deny-by-default: the broker refuses any action not explicitly allowed here.

fields.label: Read Only
fields.description: Informational: this action does not mutate anything at the connector's remote end.

fields.label: Destructive
fields.description: Informational: this action can delete or irreversibly change remote data. Surfaced to the confirmation card.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Short description of the action, taken from the connector's tools/list result.
